plan.understanding: Enlarge the aligned hole through the two central upright lugs to a 1.7 mm connecting bore, then add 0.1 mm grip grooves to its two bore walls to resist pin slippage.

subtasks.goal: On the single solid, enlarge the existing coaxial connecting bore through both central lugs from diameter 1.5 mm to diameter 1.7 mm, keeping its measured axis [1.0, 0.0, 0.0] and centerline at (Y=3.51, Z=2.943). Modify the purple full cylindrical walls faces #44 and #46 and their four mouth loops on planar faces #78, #90, #89, and #79, bounded by edge_idx [162,163,173,174]; preserve the two lug spans X=4.698..5.298 mm and X=6.948..7.548 mm and the open gap between them. Verify a radius of 0.85 mm at all four mouths and print the achieved bore centerline and diameter, correcting them in the same attempt if they differ from the stated values.

Cut uniform 0.1 mm-deep axial grip grooves into both enlarged connecting-bore walls derived from original faces #44 and #46, running parallel to the measured bore axis [1.0, 0.0, 0.0] across each complete lug thickness (X=4.698..5.298 mm and X=6.948..7.548 mm). Distribute the grooves evenly around the full circumference so the grip treatment covers both pin-contact walls, while leaving the four mouths on faces #78, #90, #89, and #79 and their outer boundaries unchanged. Verify and print the achieved groove depth, angular spacing, axial spans, and bore centerline (Y=3.51, Z=2.943), correcting any misplaced pattern in the same attempt.
